title: Story quiz: your best ad worked, what do you copy?
hook: Your best ad told a founder story. What goes in the next brief?
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

A one-question quiz on what to copy from a winning ad. Frame 2 is the quiz. Frame 3 gives the six parts of an ad. Frame 4 is the exercise to do today. Frame 5 points to Decoded #5.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames. Frame 1: Your best ad worked. What do you copy? Frame 2 is a quiz: the winner told a founder story, next brief? Frame 3 lists six parts of an ad: hook, cast, setting, pacing, proof and CTA. Frame 4: write the six parts for your last three winners. Frame 5: copy the part that worked, with a pointer to Decoded #5.
cta: Answer the quiz; read Decoded #5, link in bio

slides.headline: Your best ad worked. *What do you copy?*
The winner told a founder story. *Next brief?*
A story has *six parts.* Any one could be the reason
Write the six parts for your *last three winners*
slides.body:
What repeats across them is your best guess at why they worked.

Brief the next ad from that, and leave the story free to change.
